subject: Multilevel SEM with latent latent variables possible?

messages.author: b430763ad49e6cd0
messages.subject: Multilevel SEM with latent latent variables possible?
parts:
Dear all, 

Is it possible to build a multilevel SEM like the one given on the Lavaan website, but then with latent variables? (I.e. for which a measurement model was tested) If you can provide help with how the syntax would be done, that would be great!
Lavaan website + tutorial: http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/multilevel.html

Or is there an alternative to compute the within cluster (for my study: individuals) and between cluster correlations?

Context: 
Longitudinal study (4 time points) where a latent behaviour was measured 4 times for every individual using 4 observed variables (IT). In the syntax below, IT_t_k refers to an Item (observed variable) at time t and item k. There are missing observations, so I know it would need to be done using listwise deletion. 

My model syntax (strong measurement invariance was tested and seemed to hold, hence equal intercepts and factor loadings imposed):

Model <- 
' 
# latent Variables
Time0 =~ A1*IT_0_1 + B1*IT_0_3 + C1*IT_0_4 + E1*IT_0_6
Time1 =~ A1*IT_1_1 + B1*IT_1_3 + C1*IT_1_4 + E1*IT_1_6
Time3 =~ A1*IT_3_1 + B1*IT_3_3 + C1*IT_3_4 + E1*IT_3_6
Time4 =~ A1*IT_4_1 + B1*IT_4_3 + C1*IT_4_4 + E1*IT_4_6

# Item covariances

IT_0_1 ~~ IT_1_1 + IT_3_1 + IT_4_1
IT_1_1 ~~ IT_3_1 + IT_4_1
IT_3_1 ~~ IT_4_1 

IT_0_3 ~~ IT_1_3 + IT_3_3 +  IT_4_3 
IT_1_3 ~~ IT_3_3 + IT_4_3 
IT_3_3 ~~ IT_4_3 

IT_0_4 ~~ IT_1_4 + IT_3_4 + IT_4_4 
IT_1_4 ~~ IT_3_4 + IT_4_4 
IT_3_4 ~~ IT_4_4 

IT_0_6 ~~ IT_1_6 + IT_3_6 + IT_4_6
IT_1_6 ~~ IT_3_6 + IT_4_6
IT_3_6 ~~ IT_4_6 

Time0 ~~ Time1 + Time3 + Time4
Time1 ~~ Time3 + Time4
Time3 ~~ Time4

A1 + B1 + C1 + E1 == 4

IT_0_1 ~ a1*1
IT_1_1 ~ a1*1
IT_3_1 ~ a1*1
IT_4_1 ~ a1*1

IT_0_3 ~ b1*1
IT_1_3 ~ b1*1
IT_3_3 ~ b1*1
IT_4_3 ~ b1*1

IT_0_4 ~ c1*1
IT_1_4 ~ c1*1
IT_3_4 ~ c1*1 
IT_4_4 ~ c1*1 

IT_0_6 ~ e1*1
IT_1_6 ~ e1*1
IT_3_6 ~ e1*1
IT_4_6 ~ e1*1

a1 + b1 + c1 + e1 == 0

Time0 ~ 1
Time1 ~ 1
Time3 ~ 1
Time4 ~ 1
'

Fit <- lavaan(model = Model, data = data, auto.var = TRUE)

Thanks a lot in advance,

Amonet
